title: 第46章黄沙死战死守雄关第45章借夷制叛牵制藩王
content_zh:
朔风卷黄沙，漫天飞砾如碎刃，刮得黑褐色的关墙簌簌落土。
镇北雄关，矗立在漠南咽喉之地，墙高三丈六，青砖垒砌，历经百年风霜，棱角早已被风沙磨得斑驳，却始终牢牢锁死南北要道。可今日，这座从未陷落的雄关，彻底被黑云压城的死寂笼罩。关外黄沙旷野之上，密密麻麻的叛军阵列铺展至天际，铁甲森森，刀枪映着惨白的天光，冷得刺目。五千五百名精锐叛军，皆是常年征战、悍不畏死的亡命之徒，旌旗连绵数里，喊杀声裹挟着风沙，一波波撞在关墙上，震得城头守军耳膜生疼。
城头上，血迹早已浸透青砖，干涸的暗红层层叠叠，新旧血痕交错，腥臭与风沙的干涩交织，弥漫在整座雄关上空。原本三千镇守守军，经三日三夜连番血战，早已折损过半，余下的士卒个个带伤、筋疲力竭，握刀的手不住颤抖，眼底却依旧燃着不肯退让的星火。
真正撑起这座危城的，是四道挺立在城头最前方的身影。
陈近啸一身玄色劲装早已被鲜血浸透，深浅不一的刀伤纵横脊背、肩头，衣料破碎多处，裸露的皮肉上结着暗红血痂，又被新渗出的鲜血浸透。他手中一柄百炼长刀卷了数道缺口，刀身沾满血污，却依旧稳稳垂立地面，刀尖入砖，稳如磐石。连日鏖战，他双目布满猩红血丝，面容憔悴苍白，可周身凛冽的气场分毫未减，挺拔的脊背如同关墙最坚硬的梁柱，任凭狂风呼啸、敌军狂吠，自岿然不动。
他缓缓抬眼，望向关外无边无际的叛军洪流，沙哑的嗓音带着血战过后的粗粝，沉声道：“诸位，镇北关是北疆最后一道屏障。此关一破，漠南千里沃土尽数沦陷，百姓流离、生灵涂炭。我等身为武者，身为守关人，身后便是家国百姓，再无退路。”
话音落地，他缓缓抬手，拔出嵌在青砖中的长刀，刀锋扬起，带起一缕凛冽寒风。
“今日，我陈近啸，与镇北关共存亡！”
一句誓言，铿锵落地，震碎城头的低迷死寂。
身侧，包不同一袭青布长衫早已不复整洁，衣角撕裂、沾满尘土血渍，平日里最爱辩驳、口舌伶俐的他，此刻脸上再无半分戏谑散漫。他腰间佩剑青锋未藏，剑身清亮，在漫天黄沙中透着一抹孤绝冷光。世人皆知包不同一生执拗，凡事必辩三分、从不随众，看似桀骜乖张，实则心怀大义、风骨凛然。
他望着关外黑压压的叛军，眉头紧蹙，往日巧舌如簧的嘴，此刻只吐出短短数语，坚定无比：“我包不同一生，不认天命、不随大势，只认心中对错。叛军作乱、祸乱家国，便是不义。今日大势虽倾，我偏要逆势而行，死守此关，绝不后退半步！”
语罢，他手腕轻抖，青锋剑出鞘半寸，铮然剑鸣穿透呼啸风沙，清亮凌厉，不屈不挠。
另一侧的铁寻柳，身形魁梧挺拔，一身玄铁重甲重达百斤，三日血战下来，甲胄之上布满刀痕箭孔，凹陷破损多处，铁片缝隙间塞满干涸血垢与黄沙。他掌中一柄巨型开山斧，斧刃寒光凛冽，斧面早已被鲜血浸透，每一次挥动都带着千钧之力。铁寻柳性情沉寡言、刚烈厚重，不懂巧言虚饰，半生征战沙场，只信手中斧、心中义。
他粗重的呼吸裹挟着风沙，胸膛起伏剧烈，目光如寒潭，死死锁定关外敌军主力，沉声道：“我铁寻柳从军二十年，守过三座边关，见过万千厮杀。沙场之上，从无必胜之局，唯有必死之心。今日有我在，叛军休想踏过镇北关半步！”
没有豪言壮语，唯有铁血赤诚。沉重的开山斧在他手中微微震颤，蓄势待发，静待敌军来犯。
四人之中，唯一的女子花无艳，立于城头西风最烈处，身姿纤细却挺拔如寒梅，无惧漫天风沙、遍野尸骸。她一身素雅白衣早已被血污浸染得斑驳不堪，褪去了往日的清雅温婉，添尽沙场铁血。十指纤长，指尖却布满薄茧血痕，手中一对银月短刃，刃身纤细锋利，流转着幽幽冷光，招式灵动诡谲、招招致命。
花无艳素来淡泊名利，不喜纷争，偏爱江湖闲散，可国难当头、边关告急，她义无反顾奔赴沙场，以女子之身，立于守关最前线。她眸光清冷澄澈，不见半分惧色，唯有一腔决绝，轻声却有力地说道：“江湖儿女，亦有家国。乱世无安处，沙场有丹心。今日便以我手中双刃，护身后万家灯火，生死无悔。”
四人四影，立于残破飘摇的城头，身后是残兵疲卒，身前是五千五百精锐叛军。兵力悬殊，天差地别，可四人身上迸发的铁血气场，却牢牢稳住了整座危城的军心。残存的守军望着四道挺拔的身影，原本溃散的心神尽数归位，颤抖的双手重新握紧刀枪，眼底重燃死战到底的决然。
关外，叛军主帅勒马立于阵前，一身鎏金铠甲耀眼夺目，手持长鞭，望着残破的镇北关与寥寥数道守关身影，满脸讥讽狂傲。他起兵叛乱数年，连破北疆七座城关，从未遇过这般顽固的死守。眼前这座孤城，守军不足千人，伤痕累累、疲敝不堪，看似唾手可得，却硬生生挡了他五万大军三日三夜，迟迟无法攻克。
“区区残兵四将，也敢螳臂当车，阻我大军前路？”叛军主帅扬鞭直指城头，声音洪亮，裹挟着杀气传遍全军，“全军听令！即刻攻城！踏平镇北关，斩杀守将，破城之后，肆意劫掠、论功行赏！”

话音落下的瞬间，震天的战鼓骤然响起，咚咚巨响震彻旷野，激荡黄沙翻涌。五千五百叛军齐声嘶吼，声浪滔天，压过西风黄沙，无数攻城梯、撞车轰然推出，黑压压的兵潮如同汹涌黑浪，朝着单薄的镇北雄关猛扑而来。
黑压压的箭雨率先升空，遮天蔽日，密密麻麻的箭矢划破长空，带着凌厉破空之声，朝着城头倾泻而下。黑云压顶，箭如飞蝗，瞬间笼罩整座城关。
“结盾阵！死守城头！”陈近啸厉声大喝，声震四野。
残存的守军迅速集结，默契排布，残破的铁盾层层交错，死死护住城头防线。下一秒，万千箭矢狠狠钉在盾面之上，砰砰巨响连绵不绝，盾身剧烈震颤，无数箭矢穿透缝隙，扎入青砖与士卒躯体，惨叫声、箭矢入肉声、盾甲破碎声交织一片，惨烈至极。
陈近啸身形骤然前冲，玄色身影在箭雨之中纵横腾挪，身法迅猛沉稳。手中百炼长刀快速舞动，刀风凛冽，形成一道密不透风的刀幕，漫天飞射的箭矢尽数被格挡、劈断、击飞，断箭纷飞如雨。他目光锐利如鹰，紧盯逼近的敌军攻城梯队，沉声道：“敌军主力将至，各司其职，死守垛口，不许放一人登城！”
话音未落，第一批叛军已然冲到城墙之下，数十架攻城梯轰然架起，重重搭在青砖墙面之上，云梯顶端的铁钩死死扣住墙垛，坚硬青砖瞬间被勒出细密裂痕。无数叛军士卒手持尖刀盾牌，手脚并用，顺着云梯飞速攀爬，个个面目狰狞，悍不畏死，疯了一般朝着城头冲杀。
包不同身形一闪，已然掠至西侧垛口，青锋剑出鞘，剑光如雪，清冷凌厉。他素来心思缜密、智计无双，虽不喜蛮力厮杀，剑法却精妙绝伦、招招刁钻，专破敌军破绽。只见他身形游走在垛口之间，身姿轻盈，进退有度，剑光闪烁间，每一剑都精准挑飞敌军刺来的兵刃，刺穿攀爬士卒的咽喉心口。
不同于常人大开大合的路数，包不同的剑法灵动诡谲、变幻莫测，往往一剑递出，虚实相生，敌军防不胜防。短短数息之间，西侧云梯上十数名攀爬的叛军尽数坠下高墙，重重摔落黄沙之中，惨叫不绝。可叛军人数众多、悍勇疯狂，前仆后继、死而不退，刚清退一批，又有大批士卒顺着云梯迅猛冲上，密密麻麻、源源不断。
“螳臂当车，不自量力！”一名叛军头目悍勇过人，手持重刀，借力纵身一跃，直接从云梯中段跳上城头，重刀横扫，带着千钧蛮力，朝着包不同当头劈下，刀风霸道，势要一招毙敌。
包不同面色不改，不惊不慌，脚下步法轻转，身形侧身闪避，堪堪避开这致命一刀。重刀狠狠劈在青砖之上，瞬间劈裂大块墙砖，碎石飞溅、尘土四溅。趁着对方旧力刚去、新力未生的破绽，包不同手腕翻转，青锋剑精准刺入对方肋下空门，剑尖透体而出，鲜血喷涌。
叛军头目双目圆睁，轰然倒地，气绝身亡。
content_en:
The early wind blew up the yellow sand, flying gravel like broken knives all over the sky, causing the dark brown wall to rustle with dirt.
Zhenbei Xiongguan stands at the throat of Monan. The wall is three feet high and built with green bricks. After a hundred years of wind and frost, its edges and corners have been mottled by wind and sand, but it has always firmly blocked the main road between the north and the south. But today, this majestic pass, which has never fallen, is completely shrouded in the deathly silence of black clouds. On the yellow sand wilderness outside the pass, a dense array of rebels spread to the sky. Their armor was dense, and their swords and guns reflected the pale sky, which was dazzlingly cold. The 5,500 elite rebels were all desperadoes who had been fighting for many years and were not afraid of death. Their banners stretched for miles, and their shouts of killing were carried by the wind and sand. Wave after wave of them hit the wall, causing pain to the eardrums of the defenders at the top of the city.
On the top of the city, bloodstains have long been soaked into the blue bricks, layers of dried dark red are stacked on top of each other, new and old bloodstains are intertwined, and the fishy stench and the dryness of wind and sand are intertwined, permeating the sky above the entire Xiongguan Pass. The original three thousand garrison garrison had already lost more than half after three days and three nights of bloody battles. The remaining soldiers were all injured and exhausted. The hand holding the sword couldn't help but tremble, but there was still a spark in their eyes that refused to give in.
What really supports this dangerous city are the four figures standing at the front of the city.
Chen Jinxiao's black attire was already soaked with blood. There were stab wounds of varying depths across his back and shoulders. The material of his clothes was broken in many places. The exposed flesh was covered with dark red blood scabs and was soaked with fresh blood. A hundred-refined long knife in his hand had several notches. The blade was stained with blood, but it still stood firmly on the ground. The tip of the knife was embedded in the brick, as stable as a rock. After days of fierce fighting, his eyes were covered with scarlet bloodshot eyes, and his face was haggard and pale, but the cold aura around him had not diminished at all. His straight back was like the strongest beam in the wall, and he remained unmoved despite the howling wind and the barking of the enemy.
He slowly raised his eyes and looked at the boundless torrent of rebels outside the pass. His hoarse voice was rough after a bloody battle, and he said in a deep voice: "Everyone, Zhenbeiguan is the last barrier in the northern border. Once this pass is broken, all the fertile land in the south of the desert will fall, and the people will be displaced and their lives will be ruined. As warriors and gatekeepers, with the people of our country behind us, there is no way out."
As soon as he finished speaking, he slowly raised his hand and pulled out the long knife embedded in the green brick. The blade was raised, bringing with it a wisp of biting cold wind.
"Today, I, Chen Jinxiao, will live and die with Zhenbeiguan!"
A single oath fell to the ground, shattering the gloomy silence at the top of the city.
Beside him, Bao BuTong was wearing a long green cloth gown that was no longer neat and tidy. The corners were torn and stained with dust and blood. He who usually loved to argue and was very eloquent, now his face was no longer playful and carefree. The green blade of the sword on his waist was not hidden, and the blade was clear, showing a lonely cold light in the yellow sand in the sky. Everyone knows that Bao Tongtong was stubborn throughout his life. He always argued for three points in everything and never followed the crowd. He seemed to be unruly and perverse, but in fact he had a righteous heart and an awe-inspiring character.
He looked at the dark crowd of rebels outside the pass, his brows furrowed, and his eloquent mouth in the past could only utter a few words at this moment, and he was extremely determined: "I will not accept destiny or follow the general trend for the rest of my life. I only recognize what is right and wrong in my heart. It is unjust for the rebels to cause chaos and bring disaster to the country. Although the general trend is tilted today, I will go against the trend, defend this pass, and never take a step back!"
After saying this, he flicked his wrist, and the Qingfeng sword was half an inch out of its sheath. The sound of the sword penetrated the whistling wind and sand, clear, sharp, and unyielding.
Tie Xunliu on the other side is tall and tall, wearing heavy black iron armor weighing a hundred kilograms. After three days of bloody battle, the armor is covered with knife marks and arrow holes, with many dents and damage, and the gaps between the iron plates are filled with dried blood and yellow sand. He held a giant mountain-cutting ax in his hand. The blade of the ax was cold and the surface of the ax was already soaked with blood. Every swing carried tremendous power. Tie Xunliu has a taciturn temperament, a strong character, and does not know how to use sweet words and pretentiousness. He has been on the battlefield for half his life and only believes in the ax in his hand and the meaning in his heart.
His heavy breathing was carried by the wind and sand, his chest rose and fell violently, his eyes were like a cold pool, and he locked eyes on the main force of the enemy outside the pass. He said in a deep voice: "I, Iron Xunliu,He has been in the army for twenty years, guarded three border passes, and seen thousands of fights. On the battlefield, there is never a sure-win situation, only the determination to die. As long as I'm here today, the rebels can't even take a step past Zhenbeiguan! "
There are no heroic words, only iron-blooded sincerity. The heavy mountain ax trembled slightly in his hand, ready to go, waiting for the enemy to attack.
Among the four people, the only woman, Hua Wuyan, stood at the top of the city where the west wind was strongest. Her figure was slender but as tall as a cold plum, and she was not afraid of the wind and sand in the sky and the corpses everywhere. Her elegant white clothes had long been mottled with blood, and her former elegance and gentleness had faded away, adding to her iron blood on the battlefield. The ten fingers are long and slender, but the fingertips are covered with thin calluses and blood marks. In the hand are a pair of short silver moon blades, the blades are slender and sharp, with a faint cold light flowing, and the moves are smart, strange and deadly.
Hua Wuyan has always been indifferent to fame and fortune, does not like disputes, and prefers to be idle in the world. However, when the country is in crisis and the border is in critical condition, she rushes to the battlefield without hesitation, and as a woman, stands at the forefront of guarding the border. Her eyes were cold and clear, without any trace of fear, but with a decisive voice, she said softly but forcefully: "Children of the world also have a family and a country. There is no safe place in troubled times, but there is loyalty on the battlefield. Today, I will use the two blades in my hands to protect the lights of thousands of families behind me, and I will have no regrets in life or death. "
Four people and four figures stood on the top of the dilapidated and swaying city. Behind them were the exhausted soldiers, and in front of them were 5,500 elite rebels. There was a huge disparity in military strength, but the iron-blooded aura bursting out from the four men firmly stabilized the military morale of the entire dangerous city. The remaining defenders looked at the four tall and upright figures, their minds that had been shattered returned to their original state, their trembling hands clenched their swords and guns again, and their eyes rekindled the determination to fight to the end.
Outside the pass, the rebel commander stood in front of the formation, wearing a dazzling gilt armor and holding a long whip. He looked at the dilapidated Zhenbei Pass and the few figures guarding the pass with a sarcastic and arrogant face. He rebelled for several years and broke through seven city gates in northern Xinjiang. He had never encountered such a stubborn defense. The isolated city in front of him, with less than a thousand defenders, was scarred and exhausted, seemed to be within easy reach, but it blocked his 50,000-strong army for three days and three nights, and could not be conquered.
"How dare the four generals with only a handful of remnant soldiers use their arms as chariots to block the way forward for our army? "The rebel commander raised his whip and pointed it directly at the city. His voice was loud and filled with murderous intent and spread throughout the army, "The whole army obeys the order! Attack the city immediately! Defeat Zhenbeiguan, kill the guard, and after breaking the city, plunder and reward at will! "
The moment the words fell, the thunderous war drums suddenly sounded. The loud bangs shook the wilderness and stirred up the yellow sand. The 5,500 rebels roared in unison, with a roar that overwhelmed the west wind and yellow sand. Countless siege ladders and crashed cars were launched with a bang. The black tide of troops was like a raging black wave, rushing towards the thin Zhenbei Xiongguan Pass.
The black rain of arrows took the lead in rising into the sky, covering the sky and the sun. The dense arrows pierced the sky and poured down towards the city with a sharp sound of piercing the air. The black clouds were overwhelming, and arrows were like locusts, covering the entire city in an instant.
"Shield Formation! Defend the city! "Chen Jinxiao shouted loudly, which shocked the whole country.
The remaining defenders quickly gathered and arranged in a tacit understanding. The broken iron shields were intertwined layer by layer to protect the city's defense line. The next second, thousands of arrows were nailed hard on the shield. There was a continuous loud bang, and the shield shook violently. Countless arrows penetrated the gaps and pierced into the green bricks and the soldiers' bodies. The screams, the sound of arrows piercing flesh, and the sound of broken shields were intertwined. It was extremely tragic.
Chen Jinxiao suddenly rushed forward, his black figure moving sideways in the rain of arrows, his movements swift and steady. The Bailian long sword in his hand danced rapidly, and the sharp wind of the sword formed an airtight sword curtain. All the arrows flying in the sky were blocked, chopped, and knocked away, and the broken arrows flew like rain. His eyes were as sharp as an eagle, staring closely at the approaching enemy siege echelon, and said in a deep voice: "The main enemy force is approaching, everyone should perform their duties, guard the crenels, and no one is allowed to board the city! "
Before he finished speaking, the first batch of rebels had already rushed under the city wall. Dozens of siege ladders were suddenly set up and heavily placed on the blue brick wall.Above, the iron hook at the top of the ladder clung to the wall stack, and fine cracks were instantly pulled out of the hard blue bricks. Countless rebel soldiers were holding sharp knives and shields, using their hands and feet, and quickly climbed up the ladder. They all had ferocious faces and were not afraid of death. They rushed toward the city head like crazy.
Bao BuTong's figure flashed, and he had already reached the west side of the crenel. The green-edge sword was unsheathed, and the sword's light was like snow, cold and sharp. He has always been thoughtful and resourceful. Although he does not like to fight with brute force, his swordsmanship is exquisite and his moves are tricky, specializing in breaking the enemy's weaknesses. He was seen wandering between the crenels, his posture was light, his advance and retreat were measured, and with the flash of sword light, each sword accurately deflected the enemy's sword and pierced the throat and heart of the climbing soldier.
Different from ordinary people's open and close methods, Bao's different sword techniques are smart, treacherous, and unpredictable. They often throw out a sword, and the reality and reality are intertwined, making it difficult for the enemy to guard against. In just a few breaths, a dozen rebels climbing on the ladder on the west side all fell off the high wall and fell heavily into the yellow sand, screaming in agony. However, the rebels were numerous, brave and crazy. They fought one after another and refused to retreat. As soon as a group was cleared, a large number of soldiers rushed up quickly along the ladder, densely packed and continuous.
"The mantis' arm is like a chariot, don't underestimate your own strength!" A rebel leader was extremely brave, holding a heavy sword, and jumped directly from the middle of the ladder to the top of the city. The heavy sword swept across, and with great brute force, he slashed at Bao BuTong's head. The sword was domineering, and he was bound to kill the enemy with one move.
Bao BuTong's expression remained unchanged, he was neither alarmed nor panicked. He turned his feet lightly and dodged sideways, barely avoiding the fatal knife. The heavy knife struck hard on the green bricks, instantly splitting large pieces of wall tiles, causing gravel and dust to fly everywhere. Taking advantage of the gap where the opponent's old strength had just gone and new strength had not yet emerged, Bao Tongfeng flipped his wrist and stabbed the Qingfeng sword accurately into the empty door under the opponent's ribs. The tip of the sword came out and blood spurted out.
The rebel leader's eyes widened, he fell to the ground, and died.
